data.long_meaning: Omiansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Om' and 'Ansh'. 'Om' is the sacred syllable in Hinduism representing the ultimate reality. 'Ansh' means abode. Thus, Omiansh is a name that conveys a deep spiritual connection to the lunar cycles and the natural world.
